今天我们要
上学啦！

如果你是第一天上学，你也不用慌张、
烦恼和焦躁。

让我来告诉你，进入小学学习时，
你需要知道的一些守则。
听我来说一说吧，我可是个优等生哟。
page_text_en:
Today we're going to school!

If it's your first day of school, you don't need to be anxious, worried, or stressed.

Let me tell you some rules you need to know when starting elementary school.
Let me explain, I'm a top student, you know.
summary_zh: 画面展示孩子们在上学路上的场景，校车停在路口，孩子们过马路，右侧是学校门口，有学生和老师迎接。文字部分由一位学生介绍上学第一天的注意事项，鼓励新同学不要紧张。

我会充分利用在校时间，
我相信，你也能！
做一个好学生的秘诀很简单，
就是知道不要做什么。

守则1：
按时到校。

你要遵守的第一条守则就是：
不要迟到！
不然你会被记录在案，
老师可不喜欢等人哟！
page_text_en:
I will make full use of my time at school.
I believe you can too!
The secret to being a good student is simple:
knowing what not to do.

Rule 1:
Arrive on time.

The first rule you must follow is:
Don't be late!
Otherwise, you'll be recorded in the book,
and teachers don't like waiting for people!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了教室内的场景，老师向学生讲解上学守则，强调按时到校的重要性，同时通过对话和文字说明，鼓励学生遵守纪律、充分利用在校时间。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不要找借口。

你要遵守的第二条守则是：
不要没有礼貌。

守则2：
文明有礼。
page_text_en:
Don't make excuses.
Don't blame others.
Don't say you wanted to arrive on time,
but were held up by your family.

The second rule you must follow is:
Don't be impolite.
If you don't know what's right or wrong,
offering an apple to your teacher won't help.

Rule 2:
Be polite and civilized.

Don't daydream.

Giford's Discipline Checklist:

Don't shout, whine, or make silly noises!
Don't hit things, throw things, or spit!
Don't blow whistles, burp, or blow on people!
Don't complain, kick, or hit!
Don't cheat or copy answers!
Don't swear!
Don't talk in an annoying voice!
Don't sing too loudly or stare while singing!
Don't act like a little monster!
Don't bleat, moo, or cry!
Don't giggle, croak, or bark!
Don't slide around on the floor!
These things are forbidden!
Please follow the rules above!
I, Giford, promise I haven't missed any!

上学了，你准备好了吗？
万平（北京市特级教师、全国优秀班主任、阅读推广人、北京史家小学教师）
亲爱的家长朋友，大家好！祝贺您，孩子就要上小学了，他（她）在生活的路上又向前走了一大步，这是多么值得高兴的事情啊！高兴中也会有些许焦虑——我的孩子能够适应吗？
做好以下几个方面，相信您的孩子就能顺利融入小学学习和生活了。
1. 学习用具的准备非常重要
小学新生的书包不必过大，必须要带的书、本、铅笔、橡皮等都在其中。学习用具的收纳、管理，在别人学习时显得尤为重要。
2. 让孩子管理好自己的时间
因为学习伴随着要求和任务，小学学习和生活的时间更加有序了，要让孩子规划好学习与玩耍的时间。
3. 让孩子学会主动学习
上学后，学习中游戏的成分少了许多，更多地需要孩子集中注意力，同时也要把握好学习的节奏，放学回家，也要要求孩子主动完成老师布置的学习任务。
4. 培养良好的习惯
培养孩子准时睡觉、按时起床、按时上学等良好的生活习惯；培养孩子主动向老师问好、上课不说悄悄话等良好的行为习惯；培养孩子按照规范完成作业、遵守课堂纪律、课前预习等良好的学习习惯……
5. 学校里的小劳动任务
每个孩子都会承担一定的责任，也会轮流承担班级的一些必要的小劳动：扫地、倒垃圾、擦黑板……这些不仅是能力，还是在培养集体意识和责任意识。
6. 对孩子进行安全教育
安全是多方面的，做游戏注意安全，上下学要注意安全，饮食也要注意安全，等等。
7. 认识学校、认识老师、认识小伙伴
每个孩子对新的环境都会有一个熟悉的过程，我们要鼓励孩子主动一些，有心一些……
刚入学，起步阶段会面临诸多问题，但是这一切都会成为孩子成长的台阶；有了每一位家长对孩子的陪伴、鼓励，解决了这些问题，也就意味着孩子的脚步迈进了小学阶段的学习，意味着小学生涯真正开始了……
我们为孩子们加油，也为自己加油！

Are you ready for school?
Wan Ping (Beijing City Model Teacher, National Outstanding Class Teacher, Reading Promoter, Teacher at Beijing Shijia Primary School)
Dear parents and friends, hello! Congratulations! Your child is about to start primary school. He or she has taken another big step forward in life—how exciting! Yet, amidst the joy, there may be some anxiety—will my child be able to adapt?
By focusing on the following aspects, you can help your child smoothly integrate into primary school life and studies.
1. Preparing school supplies is very important
The schoolbag for new primary students doesn't need to be too big. Essential items like books, notebooks, pencils, and erasers should be included. Organizing and managing school supplies is especially important when others are studying.
2. Help your child manage their own time
Since learning comes with requirements and tasks, the schedule for primary school study and life becomes more structured. Help your child plan their time for studying and playing.
3. Help your child learn to study independently
After starting school, the playful elements in learning decrease significantly. Children need to focus more and manage their study pace. After school, they should also be encouraged to complete homework assigned by teachers independently.
4. Cultivate good habits
Develop good living habits such as going to bed and waking up on time, and arriving at school punctually. Encourage good behavioral habits like greeting teachers proactively and not whispering during class. Foster good study habits such as completing homework according to standards, following classroom rules, and previewing lessons before class...
5. Small labor tasks at school
Each child will take on certain responsibilities and rotate through necessary class duties such as sweeping, taking out the trash, and cleaning the blackboard... These not only build skills but also cultivate a sense of collectivism and responsibility.
6. Safety education for children
Safety covers many aspects: be careful during games, pay attention to safety when going to and from school, and be cautious about food safety, etc.
7. Get to know the school, teachers, and classmates
Every child will go through an adjustment period in a new environment. We should encourage them to be more proactive and thoughtful...
In the beginning, children will face many challenges, but all of these will become stepping stones for their growth. With the support and encouragement from every parent, overcoming these challenges means the child has truly stepped into primary school learning, marking the beginning of their primary school journey...
Let's cheer for our children, and also cheer for ourselves!
